customer_generation.prompt: Create a polished, portrait-oriented pet portrait featuring the exact same dog from reference image 1, named {dog_name}. Image 1 is the identity source of truth: preserve this dog's recognizable face, muzzle, eyes, natural ears, coat colors, markings, fur length, and age. Image 2 is the selected artwork design reference. Recreate its costume, props, color palette, artistic medium, lighting, and scene as closely as practical, adapting everything to a real dog's anatomy and proportions. Style: Grandmaster Detective. Design notes: Grandmaster Detective. Show one complete dog with a natural canine head and body, no humans, no second animal, no text, no watermark.

source_art.prompt: Create a premium fine-art pet costume portrait reference for a custom pet art gallery. Single animal subject: a Basset hound dog. Portray the animal as Grandmaster Detective wearing Victorian detective coat, refined waistcoat and deerstalker hat, no pipe. Setting: Victorian study, books and softly lit rainy window, warm walnut and olive. Cohesive collection aesthetic: refined realistic oil-painted portrait with exquisite fine fur detail and subtle brushwork, convincing fabric and metal, emotionally expressive natural animal eyes. Upright chest-up composition with the pet's authentic animal head anatomically intact above the costume; face and ears clearly recognizable, mouth closed. Head centered in the upper middle, costume visible to mid torso, generous 10 percent safe margin around ears, crown and all important details. Animal head must never become a human face. No human hands, extra paws, extra heads, malformed ears, text, lettering, watermark, frame, mat, mockup, collage or border. Flat full-bleed artwork only, vertical 4:5, suitable for reusable costume and composition reference. One pet only except the small companion explicitly requested for Dragon Guardian.

template_regeneration.prompt: Create one premium full-bleed pet portrait template, vertical 4:5, cinematic fine-art realism and detailed natural texture, beautifully art-directed for a framed print. Use the reference dog's natural face and markings. Exactly ONE dog in the scene. Dog face large, clearly visible, front or three-quarter view, eyes sharp; entire ears inside the image with comfortable 12% top breathing room. A real dog wearing dog-tailored costume, natural canine shoulders, chest, body and paws. NO human body, NO human hands, NO human characters, NO lettering, NO watermark, NO frame mockup. Category: Detectives and Secret Agents. Scene: Dog in full Victorian detective attire, seated in a dimly lit study with bookshelves, brass lamp, and rain-streaked window. Costume includes textured tweed coat, patterned waistcoat, green tie, and deerstalker hat. Composition is portrait-style, medium close-up, with warm lighting and realistic oil painting texture. Setting is an old library or study with vintage decor.. Costume: Victorian detective coat, waistcoat, tie, deerstalker hat. Natural dog anatomy under the outfit.

recipe.instruction: Match the original individual face exactly: muzzle length, skull, eye shape, ears, age and asymmetric markings. Keep the face naturally lit and attached to its own neck. Every visible animal surface must use the ORIGINAL dog coat distribution and texture, including forelegs, paws, hindquarters and tail. The erased template animal contributes no coat information. Adapt the costume pose to the source dog's natural posture and limb angles where necessary for anatomical coherence. Preserve the costume, props and composition.
